data.long_meaning: Derived from the Irish word 'dearg' meaning 'free' and 'mór' meaning 'great' or 'mighty'. This name has been borne by several notable figures in Irish history. The name Dermot carries the meaning “Free, powerful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dermot usually hope their child will grow to embody free, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Dermotus

in_english.name: Dermot

data.cultural_impact: The name Dermot holds a rich cultural significance, particularly in the Irish context. Dermot O'Brien was an important figure in the Irish Rebellion of 1641, and Dermot McMurrough is a legendary figure known for his role in bringing the Anglo-Normans to Ireland in 1169. This name is also associated with the Irish language and tradition, adding to its cultural importance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Dermot carries a spiritual significance rooted in its meaning of 'free' and 'great' or 'mighty'. This name can be seen as a reminder of the spiritual freedom that comes from being connected to a higher power and the strength and courage that comes from having faith. It can also be seen as a symbol of the mighty works of God in the world, inspiring a sense of awe and reverence.
